query:
SELECT b.id, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.amount,
                  COALESCE((
                      SELECT sum(s.base_amount)
                      FROM transaction_category_shares s
                      JOIN transactions t ON t.id = s.transaction_id
                      WHERE s.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
                        AND s.category_id = b.category_id
                        AND t.type = 'expense'
                        AND t.date >= $2 AND t.date < $3
                  ), 0) AS "spent!"
           FROM budgets b
           JOIN categories c
             ON c.id = b.category_id AND c.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
            AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
           WHERE b.workspace_id = $1 AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
           ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.name
